item.title: PicassoTiles 40pcs Magnetic Tile Clip-in Window and Door Expansion Set, Magnetic Block Add-ons, Magnet Building Construction Toys, STEM Education Learning Stacking Block, Toddler Boys & Girls
features: SWAPPABLE MAGNETIZED CLIP ONS - The magnetic set comes with 16 magnetic tiles, 8 windows, and 16 clip-in doors that can attach onto any square magnetic tile. Changeable clip-in inserts allow kids to build bigger structures with operable windows and doors perfect for any princess castle, dream house, city building, farmer's barn, skyscraper or whatever construction buildings your child can creatively imagine

IMPROVED STRONGER MAGNET - Installed with new reinforced magnets, each magnetic tile can connect onto other tiles quickly and easily without losing connection and toppling over your masterpiece. Build bigger, taller, more creative and steadier structures that are stable and secure enough to hold together.

LEARNING BY PLAYING - Never too early to start developing children's S.T.E.A.M. skills from visual training, strong sense of color, motor skill, geometrical shapes, mathematics, numbers counts, magnetic polarities, 3D architectural design to even structural engineering at an early age! Keep children occupied for hours of fun, making preschool education exciting for kids, boys & girls or toddlers to create any size masterpiece with this perfect educational gift present that won't go out of style!

ALWAYS CONNECT: the magnetic tiles click together from the top, bottom, even on the edges, no matter what orientation - they don’t collapse easily. The strong and large built-in magnets offer kids the ability to stack and build big, solid structures from the ground, on the table, or on the wall. PicassoTiles' magnetic tiles are made to fit child's hands and are made from non-toxic ABS plastic that is BPA-free and incredibly durable

ORGANIZED PLAYROOM: The magnetic tiles not only bring your kids open ended possibilities on creations, It’s also easy to put away when done playing. They will stick together easily to create a clean and organized playroom or classroom
